justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/Intents.java (304 lines). It is a final utility holder with a private constructor, 6 nested static namespaces (Scan, History, Encode, SearchBookContents, WifiConnect, Share), 37 String constants and 1 int constant, and no instance methods or behavioral logic. The contents are cohesive intent-API constants rather than a class with separable responsibilities, so insufficient modularization is not evident.
